caption:
You probably never noticed how rest days can be linked to better exercise results sometimes, 
   maybe it's time to rethink our approach to working out 🏋️‍♀️💆‍♀️
comments_seeded: What do you think happens to our bodies when we don't give them a break from exercise?

I've heard that sometimes our bodies can become less efficient at burning fat if we don't take rest days, 
     is that something that's happened to anyone else?
How often do you take rest days and what do you usually do on those days?

It's interesting to see how our bodies can adapt to different exercise routines, 
     rest days may be a crucial part of that process
What's the most notable difference you've felt in your body when you started taking regular rest days?
